bank.definition: A financial institution that accepts deposits and lends money.
examples: She deposited money at the bank.

bank.definition: Sloping land beside a river or lake.
examples: The fisherman sat on the bank of the river.

bat.definition: A nocturnal flying mammal that lives in caves and uses echolocation.
examples: A bat flew out of the cave at night.

bat.definition: A wooden or metal club used to hit a ball in baseball or cricket.
examples: The player hit the ball with a bat.

plant.definition: A living organism that grows in soil and uses sunlight to make food.
examples: The green plant needs water and sunlight.

plant.definition: An industrial factory or facility where workers manufacture goods.
examples: Workers operate machines at the industrial plant.

spring.definition: The season after winter when flowers bloom and weather becomes warmer.
A natural source of water flowing out of the ground.
examples: Fresh water flowed from the mountain spring.

spring.definition: An elastic metal coil that returns to its original shape after compression.
examples: The metal spring inside the machine compressed.

light.definition: Visible electromagnetic radiation that makes objects visible to the eye.
examples: Sunlight provides light during the day.

light.definition: Having little weight and easy to carry or lift.
examples: This bag is light and easy to carry.

crane.definition: A tall long-legged bird with a long neck and beak.
examples: A crane bird stood near the wetland.

crane.definition: A large machine used for lifting heavy objects at construction sites.
examples: The crane lifted steel beams at the construction site.

mouse.definition: A small rodent animal with a long tail.
examples: The mouse ran into its hole.

mouse.definition: A computer pointing device used to move the cursor on a screen.
examples: Click the mouse to move the computer cursor.
